evals.prompt: I'm flying to Tokyo next week - give me a quick travel brief with the forecast and a QR code for the hotel map link.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs selat skill run travel-brief --location "Tokyo" --data "<hotel maps URL>" and relays a plain-language 7-day forecast summary, notes the QR image is generated, and mentions total cost was under 0.01 USDC.
assertions: location param is set to the destination city
agent tells the user the expected cost before paying
forecast days are summarized in plain language, not raw JSON

evals.prompt: We're driving to Mount Bromo this weekend - what's the outlook, and make me a QR code for the maps link.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs selat skill run travel-brief --location "Mount Bromo" --data "<maps URL>" and relays the 7-day forecast plus confirmation that the destination QR is ready.
assertions: location param is set to the destination
data param carries the maps URL
forecast days are summarized in plain language, not raw JSON

evals.prompt: Summarize this article about renewable energy for me.
Generate a QR code for my Wi-Fi password.
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger on its own (single-purpose QR request; the QR step exists only inside a travel brief).
assertions: travel-brief is not selected as a whole-skill match for an isolated QR task

evals.prompt: Which country is the IP 8.8.8.8 located in?
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger (IP lookups are out of scope for a travel brief).
assertions: travel-brief is not selected for IP geolocation tasks
